A white or almost white hygroscop- ic powder. Very slightly soluble in water and in dichloromethane; slightly soluble in alcohol. It dissolves in dilute solutions of alkali hydroxides. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. USP 31 (Ioxaglic Acid). Store at a temperature of 25°, excursions permitted between 15° and 30°.
